title: ISS statistics: futures series
description: The actual series channel — asset_code groups contracts (e.g. RTS-9.26/RTS-12.26 -> RTS), name and underlying_asset are what plan_refresh writes onto futures_series.name/underlying_key instead of leaving them null. underlying_asset is legitimately blank for part of the universe (e.g. commodity futures with no single spot underlying); series_refresh.py must not treat that as a parse failure.
